# Native view preflight — diagnostic only

This isolated workflow builds the reviewed selected-tree-source commit using the original staged architecture typecheck, complete tests, build and twelve-GLB verification commands. Each native case restores only that build job's immutable artifact ID and digest. The source commit/tree, full extracted inventory, staged source/index marker, original source files and actual document/JavaScript response bodies are independently bound before and after collection. The original compiled build is never patched.

Desktop uses the original 1280×800 viewport and phone uses 390×844, both at DPR 1. The original headed Chrome/Metal launch, reduced motion, service-worker block, normal default graphics, public Guide actions, native F dismount, conditional native V first-person transition and original settle criterion are retained. The original `automatic` quality, `60` FPS cap and `automatic` anti-aliasing values are asserted only by reading controls. There is no `isMobile`/`hasTouch` override, graphics change, camera setter, input injection through gameplay APIs, render override or screenshot production. Every site's native F pair and each necessary V pair must occur in its own recorded phase.

At each site's settled arrival the harness records complete raw snapshots, exterior bounds/camera/projected corners and one `viewObstructions(id)` result from the fixed source in a single synchronous browser evaluation. The unchanged frame counter and identical camera receipts bind those observations to the same actual pose. Partial values and individual read status survive a later observation failure. It imports the exact source-pinned original `createExteriorPlanner` and calls its constructor once. Every original 2 m grid point and unmodified `routeGround` result is retained in order, with the original 10,000-point batches and 200,000-point total guard. Ground receipts preserve the original 0.7/2.25 m planning occupancy, body heights and hit arrays. Nonfinite numbers, negative zero and undefined values use an explicit reversible JSON scalar encoding rather than silently becoming null.

The harness never accesses or calls the returned route function. Both the directed route-sweep callback and a constructor view-query callback throw. It does not choose a viewpoint, walk a route, steer toward an endpoint, remove scenery, change collision queries or relax the original planner's 64-attempt limit. Complete raw inputs permit later comparison of both front/rear diagonal families and opposite-compatible pairs without retaining only a favored endpoint. The original target bounds, camera FOV/aspect, projected corners and 5% framing criterion are not modified.

The new diagnostic has its own ten-minute case deadline followed by at most thirty seconds of bounded cleanup. This does not change, replace or satisfy the existing 32-minute full exterior route deadline, native ninety-second performance ride, view-image requirements, collision checks or release gates. All reports explicitly mark those acceptance scopes false. A successful collection only means that these diagnostic observations were complete and source-bound. Future LOD silhouettes, actual unobstructed PNGs and complete route feasibility still require their original evidence.

Raw files are written as they are received, including partial failures. Observer event overflow, missing bytes, changed source/build/graphics, nonnative input, software rendering, incomplete grid receipts, unsupported counters or any requested route/sweep work fail closed. Unsupported geometry is retained verbatim as an observation limitation, never treated as a visibility pass. The full original build ZIP remains in its immutable Actions artifact; native evidence retains metadata, CRC/digest provenance and complete inventory without uploading a duplicate ZIP.

`pins.json` must identify the independently reviewed fixed source. There is no fallback to PR266 or another historical build. The diagnostic PR contains only its own `.github/diagnostics/belle-view-preflight/` files and workflow, additive over the reviewed source branch. It does not edit acceptance workflows or application files.

The original build rewrites one tracked research receipt, `street-detail-stats.json`, with elapsed `buildMs`. The build stage archives both the actual generated bytes and the exact pinned Git bytes, requires finite nonnegative durations and identical values for every other JSON field, rejects any other tracked diff, then restores only that generated research receipt before enforcing an unchanged source checkout. No runtime or compiled-build bytes receive an exception.

Focused checks: `node --test "$bundle/contract.test.mjs" "$bundle/grid.test.mjs" "$bundle/source.test.mjs"`, with `PREFLIGHT_PLANNER_PATH` set to the pinned application's original exterior planner. Python archive safety checks run with `python3 "$bundle/restore-build.test.py"`. No native browser case is run by these focused tests.
